# HyperOS Dialer for Global ROMs **Brings the native HyperOS dialer to Global ROMs that ship with Google Dialer.** [![Release](https://img.shields.io/github/v/release/Mods-Center/HyperOS-Dialer?style=for-the-badge&label=release&color=0a84ff)](https://github.com/Mods-Center/HyperOS-Dialer/releases/latest) [![Downloads](https://img.shields.io/github/downloads/Mods-Center/HyperOS-Dialer/total?style=for-the-badge&color=30d158)](https://github.com/Mods-Center/HyperOS-Dialer/releases) [![Stars](https://img.shields.io/github/stars/Mods-Center/HyperOS-Dialer?style=for-the-badge&color=ffd60a)](https://github.com/Mods-Center/HyperOS-Dialer/stargazers) [![Telegram](https://img.shields.io/badge/Telegram-channel-26A5E4?style=for-the-badge&logo=telegram&logoColor=white)](https://t.me/kashis_cringey_stuffs)
## Features - Replaces Google Dialer with the HyperOS dialer for a call experience that matches the rest of the system - Choose your options with the volume keys during installation ## Requirements - HyperOS Global ROM - Magisk, KernelSU or APatch ## Installation 1. Download the latest zip from [**Releases**](https://github.com/Mods-Center/HyperOS-Dialer/releases/latest). 2. If an older version is installed, remove it and reboot first. 3. Flash the zip in Magisk / KernelSU and choose your options with the volume keys. 4. Reboot the device. 5. Set the HyperOS Dialer as default in **Settings → Apps → Default apps**. ---

HyperOS Dialer for Global ROMs

Brings the native HyperOS dialer to Global ROMs that ship with Google Dialer.

![Release](https://github.com/Mods-Center/HyperOS-Dialer/releases/latest)

![Downloads](https://github.com/Mods-Center/HyperOS-Dialer/releases)

![Stars](https://github.com/Mods-Center/HyperOS-Dialer/stargazers)

![Telegram](https://t.me/kashis_cringey_stuffs)

Features

  • Replaces Google Dialer with the HyperOS dialer for a call experience that matches the rest of the system
  • Choose your options with the volume keys during installation

    • Requirements

  • HyperOS Global ROM
  • Magisk, KernelSU or APatch

    • Installation

  • Download the latest zip from [**Releases**](https://github.com/Mods-Center/HyperOS-Dialer/releases/latest).
  • If an older version is installed, remove it and reboot first.
  • Flash the zip in Magisk / KernelSU and choose your options with the volume keys.
  • Reboot the device.
  • Set the HyperOS Dialer as default in **Settings → Apps → Default apps**.
